subject: Re: Unable to Upload My Manuscript
body:
Dear Yang Liu,

Thank you for your email regarding the difficulty you are experiencing uploading your manuscript to the ICCBDA 2027 submission system. We understand that the page shows an error after you click the Submit button, and that the problem persists when using two different browsers.

To help us investigate, please provide the following details:
- A screenshot of the error message
- The exact error message text
- Your submission ID (if available)
- The browser(s) and version(s) you used
- Your operating system
- The file format and size of the manuscript
- The time the issue occurred

Once we receive this information, we can look into the matter further. If you have any additional context, please include it.

For reference, the full paper submission deadline is February 15, 2027.

Best regards,
Conference Secretariat
ICCBDA 2027
iccbda2027@example.org
